program.section_heading: Apprenticeship: Manufacturing Technician II - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Apply industry standard safety practices and specific safety requirements for different machining operations.
Produce high precision parts out of a variety of conventional machine tools.
Demonstrate advanced manufacturing technical practices and procedures that are applicable to all sectors of manufacturing.
Demonstrate knowledge of CNC specific technical work practices, such as blueprint reading, applied math concepts, tools, and measurement concepts.

notes: The section covers both the A.S. Degree and the Certificate of Achievement (NAS967/C/NCE967); the requirements and the Program Learning Outcomes list are printed once and shared by both awards. The outcomes were recorded for the A.S. Degree.
The Required courses block states 16.00 units but lists only APP-450 at 4.00 units. APP-450 may be taken repeatedly, perhaps 4 times, to reach 16 units; a reviewer should check this.

The Elective Courses block states 14.00-15.00 units. However, the listed items (each 'Choose one course' pair counted once, plus MAN-35, MAN-36, MAN-56 and MAN-57) sum to 28 units. I read the block as choosing courses totaling at least 14 units from the list, and modeled each 'Choose one course' OR pair as one entry with an alternative. The catalog does not say clearly how the 14-15 units are to be selected, so a reviewer should check this reading.
The catalog total is 30.00-31.00 units, which matches 16 required units plus 14-15 elective units.
The degree requires general education, but the text names no specific GE pattern, so ge_pattern is null.

Codes are written as printed with hyphens (e.g., ENE-30), while the closed list uses spaces (ENE 30). DFT, ELE and APP codes, ENE-42 and MAN-35 are not in the closed list and are marked as catalog additions.
